values.en: For a regular smooth parametrized surface $X\colon\mathbb{R}^{2}\to\mathbb{R}^{3}$ and $q\in\Omega$, the **unit normal** is $\boldsymbol{N}_{X}(q)=\dfrac{\partial_{1}X(q)\times\partial_{2}X(q)}{\lVert\partial_{1}X(q)\times\partial_{2}X(q)\rVert}$. The denominator is nonzero precisely because $X$ is regular: $\partial_{1}X(q),\partial_{2}X(q)$ are linearly independent, so their cross product does not vanish and $\boldsymbol{N}_{X}(q)$ is well defined and unit. It is orthogonal to $T_{q}X$, and it gives a **local** orientation: the sign is fixed by the chosen ordering $(\partial_{1},\partial_{2})$ of the parameters.
values.zh-CN: 对正则光滑参数曲面 $X\colon\mathbb{R}^{2}\to\mathbb{R}^{3}$ 与 $q\in\Omega$，**单位法向量**为 $\boldsymbol{N}_{X}(q)=\dfrac{\partial_{1}X(q)\times\partial_{2}X(q)}{\lVert\partial_{1}X(q)\times\partial_{2}X(q)\rVert}$。分母非零正是由 $X$ 的正则性保证的：$\partial_{1}X(q),\partial_{2}X(q)$ 线性无关，故叉积不为零，$\boldsymbol{N}_{X}(q)$ 有定义且为单位向量。它与 $T_{q}X$ 正交，并给出**局部**定向：符号由参数次序 $(\partial_{1},\partial_{2})$ 固定。

values.en: Unit Normal Vector of a Parametrized Surface
